narratives.Description: Narrow `directive update` to refresh-only + self-heal of an EXISTING Directive install so it is never the hidden first-run adoption command. It refreshes only framework-owned payload and managed files, self-heals the engine through the keystone global-first ladder when needed, writes only the non-destructive .gitignore entry (never git rm --cached), and reports exactly one of four states: not-initialized (stop, hint init), current, updated, or migration-required. Behavior half of #2199; the version half is the keystone #2264.
narratives.Overview:
Part of epic #2203. Absorbs #2199 (behavior half; version half is #child A #2264).

## Summary

Narrow `directive update` to **refresh-only + self-heal** of an existing Directive install. `update` is never the hidden first-run adoption command.

## Contract (Decisions 2, 3, 4, 6)

- Valid install exists -> refresh framework-owned payload + managed files; run the global-first ladder (#child A) to self-heal the engine when needed; forward-migrate content and re-stamp `VERSION`.
- No install exists -> stop: `This project is not initialized. Run directive init.` (Never create a partial install.)
- Initialized + current -> report no update needed.
- Migration required -> report update is not enough; point to `directive init` or the exact `migrate` command.
- **Non-destructive `.gitignore` write only**: `update` may add the ignore entry for framework-owned paths, but it MUST NOT run the destructive `git rm --cached .deft/core` -- that is the deliberate `migrate --untrack-core` step (#child F #2269, merged).
- Output distinguishes `not initialized` / `current` / `updated` / `migration required`.

## Acceptance criteria

- `update` in a non-Directive project does not create a partial install and prints the `init` hint.
- `update` in an initialized project refreshes only framework-owned files.
- Self-heal path works in a mismatched env (delegates to #child A ladder).
- `update` writes the gitignore entry but never un-tracks `.deft/core`.
- `--dry-run` / `--plan` supported; idempotent.
- Tests cover initialized, uninitialized, current, stale, migration-needed, and mismatched-env states.

## Related

Absorbs #2199. Depends on #child A (#2264). Un-track is #child F (#2269). Parent #2203.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer with an existing install, I want `directive update` to refresh only the framework-owned payload and self-heal the engine via the resolution ladder while refusing to create a partial install or run any destructive git rm, so that updating is a safe idempotent refresh that clearly reports whether the project was not-initialized or current or updated or migration-required.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. In `packages/core/src/init-deposit/refresh.ts` (the runRefreshDeposit orchestrator behind runRefreshDepositCli), add an explicit state classifier that returns one of {not-initialized, current, updated, migration-required} BEFORE any copy: reuse the keystone `classify()`/`plan()` from `packages/core/src/resolution/` to detect install presence, current-vs-stale, and migration-required; when not-initialized, STOP with `This project is not initialized. Run directive init.` and never write a partial install.
2. Self-heal: when the engine is unreachable/mismatched, delegate to the keystone `engine-ladder.ts` (global-first) to resolve/self-heal, then proceed with the refresh; keep the existing content re-copy + managed-section re-render + VERSION re-stamp for the updated path.
3. Enforce non-destructive boundary: `update` may write the `.gitignore` entry via `init-deposit/gitignore.ts` but MUST NOT call any `git rm --cached` path (that belongs to #2269 migrate --untrack-core); assert this with a boundary test.
4. Add `--dry-run`/`--plan` to `CANONICAL_UPDATE_ARGV` in `packages/cli/src/init-cli/constants.ts` and thread the flag through `packages/cli/src/init-cli/update.ts` so the classified plan prints without executing; keep the verb idempotent.
5. Colocated vitest in `refresh.test.ts` (+ an update CLI test) covering not-initialized/current/updated/migration-required/mismatched-env and the dry-run + idempotency paths. Add a brief CHANGELOG entry. Run `task ts:check-lane`, targeted vitest, and `task check:framework-source`.
